status: frozen retrospective analysis before opening archived performance

partition.group: transitive connected component of publisher source/source question ID or exact normalized question text
partition.allocation: floor development and calibration group counts separately, then remainder heldout, ordered by SHA-256 seed|subject|numeric group ID

primary.baseline: highest full-plan calibration accuracy, ties by fixed source-manifest model order
primary.estimand: heldout paired full-plan correctness of fixed all-panel strict majority minus selected single baseline
primary.abstention: incorrect for full-plan accuracy; coverage and conditional accuracy reported separately

voting.majority: strictly more than half of all selected members
voting.plurality: unique highest valid vote count, or seeded tie; no valid votes means abstention
voting.unanimity: every selected member must give the same valid canonical option
voting.tieRule: indices sorted ascending; use unsigned low 32 bits of (question ID xor seed) times 2654435761, modulo number of tied options

selection.randomRule: single deterministic uniform enumeration index per committee size using unsigned xorshift32 and rejection sampling
selection.complementarity: mean individual calibration accuracy minus 0.5 times mean pairwise joint-error excess over the product of marginal errors
selection.optimization: exhaustive all equal-sized subsets; distinctFamilies enforces one checkpoint per family; directVote maximizes strict-majority full-plan calibration correct count

bootstrap.group: canonical source-question group, sampled with replacement within subject
bootstrap.multipleTesting: one primary comparison; all secondary estimates and intervals descriptive with no multiplicity-adjusted claims

references.homogeneous: exact binomial conditional on mean calibration correctness
references.heterogeneous: exact Poisson-binomial conditional on per-model calibration correctness
references.categorical: independent calibration distributions of correct, ordered wrong rank, or invalid; fixed alpha=1 per eligible category. Condition on subject and actual option count when n>=20; otherwise use subject and pool then renormalize to eligible ranks.
references.repair: 500 independent permutations of each calibration model's relative-to-gold answers within exact subject and eligible option-count strata; target heldout structural weights across strata with calibration coverage; report unsupported target count
references.difficulty: Pearson error correlation after subtracting model-specific calibration rates by subject and publisher source with n>=15; otherwise subject rates. Descriptive aggregate difficulty proxy.

higherOrder.matching: sorted individual calibration accuracies and sorted pairwise phi, required tolerances for every coordinate, rank by sum of absolute discrepancies then fixed enumeration; compare selected pair descriptively on heldout; if none passes, report inadequate matches

coverage.confidence: no comparable expressed confidence data; withhold confidence weighting
